recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **All-purpose flour:** 360 g
- **Baking soda:** 5 g ([**2:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=157s))
- **Baking powder:** 3 g ([**2:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=171s))
- **Sea salt:** 5 mL ([**2:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=171s))
- **Ground cinnamon:** 5–10 mL ([**3:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=202s))
- **Ginger powder:** 5 mL ([**3:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=202s))
- **Granulated white sugar:** 200 g ([**4:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=253s))
- **Brown sugar:** 200–210 g ([**4:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=253s))
- **Vegetable oil:** 350 g ([**4:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=288s))
- **Eggs:** 3 large eggs ([**4:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=297s))
- **Vanilla paste:** 10 mL (or vanilla extract) ([**5:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=322s))
- **Ripe bananas:** 5 bananas ([**0:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=49s))
- **Crushed pineapple:** 227 g (with the juice included) ([**1:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=83s))
- **Walnuts:** 120 g (chopped) ([**5:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=322s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• All-purpose flour: 360 g
  • Baking soda: 5 g (2:37)
  • Baking powder: 3 g (2:51)
  • Sea salt: 5 mL (2:51)
  • Ground cinnamon: 5–10 mL (3:22)
  • Ginger powder: 5 mL (3:22)
  • Granulated white sugar: 200 g (4:13)
  • Brown sugar: 200–210 g (4:13)
  • Vegetable oil: 350 g (4:48)
  • Eggs: 3 large eggs (4:57)
  • Vanilla paste: 10 mL (or vanilla extract) (5:22)
  • Ripe bananas: 5 bananas (0:49)
  • Crushed pineapple: 227 g (with the juice included) (1:23)
  • Walnuts: 120 g (chopped) (5:22)
recipe-section-1.title: For the Cake Base

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Butter:** 340 g, ice-cold ([**9:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=556s))
- **Philadelphia cream cheese:** 250 g+, ice-cold ([**9:35**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=575s))
- **Vanilla:** 5 mL ([**10:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=632s))
- **Powdered sugar:** Approx. 723 g ([**12:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=772s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Butter: 340 g, ice-cold (9:16)
  • Philadelphia cream cheese: 250 g+, ice-cold (9:35)
  • Vanilla: 5 mL (10:32)
  • Powdered sugar: Approx. 723 g (12:52)
recipe-section-2.title: For the Cream Cheese Frosting

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- Preheat your oven to 175 °C ([**3:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=232s)).
- Grease three 20.3 cm silicone cake molds with non-stick spray ([**6:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=406s)).
recipe-section-4.html:
• Preheat your oven to 175 °C (3:52).
  • Grease three 20.3 cm silicone cake molds with non-stick spray (6:46).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Prep and Oven Setup

recipe-section-5.markdown:
- Peel 5 very ripe bananas and place them in a mixing bowl ([**0:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=49s)).
- *Tip:* If your bananas aren't ripe enough, bake them at 175 °C for 10 minutes until black and soft ([**0:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=37s)).
- Mash them completely using a potato ricer or fork ([**0:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=49s)).
- Add 227 g of crushed pineapples with their juice and mix with the ricer until combined ([**1:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=83s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
• Peel 5 very ripe bananas and place them in a mixing bowl (0:49).
  • Tip: If your bananas aren't ripe enough, bake them at 175 °C for 10 minutes until black and soft (0:37).
  • Mash them completely using a potato ricer or fork (0:49).
  • Add 227 g of crushed pineapples with their juice and mix with the ricer until combined (1:23).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Mash the Wet Baseos

recipe-section-6.markdown:
- Place the bowl on a kitchen scale and zero it out ([**4:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=253s)).
- Weigh in 360 g of all-purpose flour, 5 g of baking soda, and 3 g of baking powder ([**2:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=141s)).
- Add 5 mL of sea salt, 5–10 mL of cinnamon, and 5 mL of ginger powder ([**2:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=171s)).
- Weigh out 200 g of white granulated sugar and 200–210 g of brown sugar directly into the mix ([**4:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=253s)).
recipe-section-6.html:
• Place the bowl on a kitchen scale and zero it out (4:13).
  • Weigh in 360 g of all-purpose flour, 5 g of baking soda, and 3 g of baking powder (2:21).
  • Add 5 mL of sea salt, 5–10 mL of cinnamon, and 5 mL of ginger powder (2:51).
  • Weigh out 200 g of white granulated sugar and 200–210 g of brown sugar directly into the mix (4:13).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Combine Dry Spices & Sugars

recipe-section-7.markdown:
- Pour in 350 g of vegetable oil, 3 large eggs, and 10 mL of vanilla paste ([**4:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=288s)).
- Toss in 115–120 g of chopped walnuts ([**5:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=322s)).
- *Scale safety rule:* Remove the bowl from your kitchen scale before mixing so you do not damage the scale's calibration ([**5:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=332s)). [[1](https://youtu.be/dffGfhgZ9uo#:~:text=This%20old%20fashioned%20hummingbird%20cake%20recipe%20is,delight%20your%20guests%20on%20any%20special%20occasion!)]
recipe-section-7.html:
• Pour in 350 g of vegetable oil, 3 large eggs, and 10 mL of vanilla paste (4:48).
  • Toss in 115–120 g of chopped walnuts (5:22).
  • Scale safety rule: Remove the bowl from your kitchen scale before mixing so you do not damage the scale's calibration (5:32). [1]
recipe-section-7.title: Step 4: Wet Ingredients & Walnuts

recipe-section-8.markdown:
- Using a simple spatula, fold the batter completely by hand ([**1:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=74s)).
- Mix only until the ingredients are just combined and no flour lumps remain ([**1:04**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=64s)). Do not overmix.
- Divide the batter evenly among the three prepared pans using a scale for accuracy (approx. 464–500 g per pan) ([**7:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=453s)).
- Bake at 175 °C for roughly 25 minutes. Let the cakes cool entirely overnight before frosting ([**8:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=516s)).
recipe-section-8.html:
• Using a simple spatula, fold the batter completely by hand (1:14).
  • Mix only until the ingredients are just combined and no flour lumps remain (1:04). Do not overmix.
  • Divide the batter evenly among the three prepared pans using a scale for accuracy (approx. 464–500 g per pan) (7:33).
  • Bake at 175 °C for roughly 25 minutes. Let the cakes cool entirely overnight before frosting (8:36).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 5: Mix and Bake

recipe-section-10.markdown:
- To keep the frosting stable, use **ice-cold** butter and cream cheese straight from the fridge ([**8:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=524s)).
- Add 340 g of cold butter pieces and 250 g of cold cream cheese into a bowl with 5 mL of vanilla ([**9:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=556s)).
- Use a hand mixer to beat them together ([**10:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=652s)). Because it is cold, it will take a moment to integrate ([**11:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=693s)).
- *Fixing lumps:* If the butter chunks are stubborn, transfer the mix to a microwave-safe bowl and nuke it for 15 seconds to soften slightly ([**14:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=880s)).
recipe-section-10.html:
• To keep the frosting stable, use ice-cold butter and cream cheese straight from the fridge (8:44).
  • Add 340 g of cold butter pieces and 250 g of cold cream cheese into a bowl with 5 mL of vanilla (9:16).
  • Use a hand mixer to beat them together (10:52). Because it is cold, it will take a moment to integrate (11:33).
  • Fixing lumps: If the butter chunks are stubborn, transfer the mix to a microwave-safe bowl and nuke it for 15 seconds to soften slightly (14:40).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 1: Beat the Base

recipe-section-11.markdown:
- Gradually mix in up to 723 g of powdered sugar ([**12:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=772s)).
- Beat on high speed until the texture turns thick, smooth, and glossy ([**13:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=814s)).
recipe-section-11.html:
• Gradually mix in up to 723 g of powdered sugar (12:52).
  • Beat on high speed until the texture turns thick, smooth, and glossy (13:34).
recipe-section-11.title: Step 2: Add Sugar

recipe-section-12.markdown:
- Place your first cake layer down on a piece of parchment paper on a cake turntable ([**18:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=1083s)).
- Spread a generous layer of cream cheese frosting evenly over the layer using a cake spatula ([**18:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=1097s)).
- Stack the second layer, add more frosting, and top with the third cake layer ([**18:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=1126s)).
- Coat the outside of the cake. Use rustic, decorative "swoops" with your spatula on the top and sides for a clean, homemade look ([**22:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=1325s)).
- Chill the cake in the refrigerator before serving ([**12:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dffGfhgZ9uo&t=743s)).
recipe-section-12.html:
• Place your first cake layer down on a piece of parchment paper on a cake turntable (18:03).
  • Spread a generous layer of cream cheese frosting evenly over the layer using a cake spatula (18:17).
  • Stack the second layer, add more frosting, and top with the third cake layer (18:46).
  • Coat the outside of the cake. Use rustic, decorative "swoops" with your spatula on the top and sides for a clean, homemade look (22:05).
  • Chill the cake in the refrigerator before serving (12:23).
recipe-section-12.title: Step 3: Assemble and Decorate
